title: Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT i
question:
Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT is grater than 400, what is the funding type of these schools?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Average of average math = sum(average math scores) / count(schools).

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_047, s.XCL_065
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON t.XCL_030 = s.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_045 = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.XCL_041, s.XCL_047, s.XCL_065
HAVING AVG(t.XCL_038) > 400
